{"CommandLine":"powershell -NoProfile -Command "
Get-ChildItem -Path 'c:\AI-BS' -Filter '*install*' -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 20 FullName, Length, LastWriteTime
Get-ChildItem -Path 'c:\AI-BS\BroadcastStudioApp' -Recurse -Depth 2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.exe', '.msi', '.iss', '.nsi', '.json' } | Select-Object FullName, Length
"","Cwd":"c:\AI-BS","IsDaemon":false,"WaitMsBeforeAsync":5000,"toolAction":"Finding installer files","toolSummary":"Search for installer files in workspace"}
